name: lsp-flake
description: Language servers installed as one Nix flake, wired into Claude Code as one plugin

plugins.name: nix-lsps
plugins.description: Ten language servers for Claude Code (bash, PHP incl. .phtml, Java, Kotlin, Nix, Python, Rust, TypeScript, Vue, YAML). Needs its binaries installed separately: nix profile add github:Tschallacka/lsp-flake#lsps — then run /lsp-doctor to check.
